model_prior_families.summary: Gaussian intercept/midterm/main and pooled interaction/community/state terms feed a sigmoid cell propensity.
kappa ~ LogNormal(log(100),0.7); no official count factors means all eventG values take Gamma(kappa,kappa) prior branch.
one scalar per contest: sigmoid(Normal(logit(.98),.5) baseline plus pooled race effect with scale .3.
selected IID per-candidate utility and profile softmax; nonmajor candidate effect Normal(-3,1), except sole-other Normal(-.3,1); no role hierarchy selected.
per-contest Dirichlet(ones) over noncandidate categories when width>1.
eight fixed parent masses .125; not likelihood-updated by this ledger.
